messages:
Lena: FYI hit a weird onboarding bug in the node sample: request ids change on retry and redaction missed inline code secrets when OTEL_AUTO_INIT=1.
Omar: can you share logs?
Lena: snippet: ```
INFO auth: token ok
DEBUG http: req=rid-42 -> POST /v1/chat
WARN  http: 401
DEBUG http: req=rid-99 -> retry POST /v1/chat
```
Lena: note the second req id; also body had `api_key: `xxxxx`` and it showed up unredacted.
Priya: sounds like two things: (A) retry layer regenerates request id, (B) otel auto-init toggles log level before our redaction hook wires.
Omar: for (A) make retry reuse ctx.requestId if present. small change in retry-sender. add a unit test asserting header persists across attempts.
Priya: for (B) propose adding a logging.Filter that redacts message.getMessage() as last line of defense, plus move our redaction middleware earlier where possible.
Lena: agree. also add an env guard OTEL_AUTO_INIT=false in quickstart docs to avoid confusing new users.
ci-bot: created branch fix/reqid-reuse-and-redact-filter, running unit tests.
devx-bot: ticket DX-1205 created "reqid reuse on retry + logging redaction filter for otel-autoinit"; linked PR #501.
Omar: i'll open the PR with tests for node+python parity. assign to Priya for review.
Priya: will review. after merge, we'll cut a patch and update onboarding doc with the OTEL_AUTO_INIT note.
Lena: thanks all, caught during a live customer demo so urgent but manageable.
